scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: At turn 1 and turn 12, the customer expressed frustration over prolonged sub-guarantee speeds, but you offered no acknowledgment of her situation.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: You did not paraphrase or restate the customer's speed guarantee claim at any point in the call.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: The customer stated at turn 7 that she tested on her Lenovo laptop wired to port 1, but at turn 29 you asked her again which computer model she was using.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At turn 13, you deflected responsibility by telling the customer to take up her speed guarantee credit dispute with Openreach directly.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: At turn 15, you spoke condescendingly to the customer by stating 'If you actually bothered to read the minimum guaranteed speed clause'.

grader.scenario: Broadband speed guarantee credit claim after sync speed remained below 45 Mbps minimum
grader.notes: Nathan performs technical troubleshooting and successfully reprofiles the line to 53 Mbps while applying a £30 guarantee credit. However, his customer service shows multiple severe faults: he fails Empathy by ignoring Elena's frustration, defers responsibility to Openreach ('take it up with Openreach directly'), insults her reading comprehension, fails to paraphrase, and repeats a hardware question already answered.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [02:15] Managed holds announced and resumed within 45 seconds without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:15] Customer: 'I'm calling to claim the broadband speed guarantee credit. My sync speed has stayed down at thirty-eight megabits for over three weeks...', Agent responds with immediate verification questions without sympathy.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the core issue in his own words; only confirmed contact number at turn 50.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:15] Customer: 'I ran the official tests on my Lenovo laptop wired directly to port 1 of the router.' followed by Agent at [07:40]: 'Which computer model were you using to run the speed test?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [02:10] Agent: 'Speed guarantees are handled by Openreach line engineering, so you'll have to take up any credit dispute with Openreach directly.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [02:30] Agent: 'If you actually bothered to read the minimum guaranteed speed clause in your terms, you'd know it allows a thirty-day cure window before compensation applies.'
